mapper.delete: UPDATE conversation SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM conversation WHERE user_a_id = #{userAId} AND user_b_id = #{userBId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation ( id, user_a_id, user_b_id, last_message, last_message_at, a_unread, b_unread, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userAId}, #{userBId}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMessageAt}, 0, 0, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_message_at = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE conversation SET
a_unread = a_unread + 1,
b_unread = b_unread + 1,
update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE conversation SET
a_unread = 0,
b_unread = 0,
update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
